cc:Work.dc:description: All 194 processed observations are shown at their individual temperatures, without connecting mixed-temperature points. The source curve uses the published EOS snapshot and source scale; the reconstruction uses the archived independent Python fit. Both reconstruct pressure from the same observed V or KS and T, including the source's operational KS conversion and exact scale groups. Residual = calculated − observed pressure (GPa). Panel RMS is unweighted and differs from the effective-variance chi-square; error bars show the supplied P/value errors, while temperature errors also enter the fit. Full input/error/group tokens and the later author-log/native comparison are linked in the dedicated replay report. Original raw-study reduction/exclusion history remains partial.
